Vecify is a Spanish deep-tech company developing an engineering platform that enables space and other regulated-critical industries to design, test, iterate, and certify complex systems within a single continuously traceable environment aligned with the V-model and ECSS standards.
Space programs operate under highly rigorous verification and certification frameworks, yet traceability, verification matrices, and compliance evidence are still largely managed through fragmented tools and document-driven processes. As spacecraft, launchers and avionics systems grow in complexity, this approach introduces schedule risk, costly rework during Phase C/D, and audit friction at major review milestones.
Vecify unifies system architecture, requirements, verification and validation (V&V), risks, configuration baselines, and certification evidence into a structured engineering model. Compliance is not treated as a downstream documentation task, but as an integrated and continuously managed property of the system.
At its core, Vecify integrates explainable AI to assist with regulatory interpretation, automated traceability, and real-time change-impact analysis across ECSS workflows. Engineers remain fully in control, while certification readiness becomes continuous. All AI-supported outputs are auditable, transparent, and compatible with certification authority expectations. Vecify combines domain expertise with advanced AI capabilities supported by the Barcelona Supercomputing Center AI Factory.
Vecify’s objective is to strengthen Europe’s digital mission assurance capabilities and enable faster, safer certification of critical space systems.

Confagricoltura Campania is the regional branch of the Confederazione Generale dell’Agricoltura Italiana, one of the oldest and most prominent organisations representing the agricultural sector in Italy. The organisation represents approximately 8,000 agricultural enterprises in the Campania region and plays a key role in supporting agricultural employers and promoting the development of the agri-food sector.
Operating in a region characterised by rich biodiversity and high-value agri-food supply chains, Confagricoltura Campania works to strengthen the competitiveness, sustainability and innovation capacity of agricultural enterprises. The organisation acts as a key interlocutor with regional, national and European institutions, fostering dialogue between farmers, public authorities and other stakeholders.
Confagricoltura Campania provides a wide range of services to support agricultural businesses, including labour relations management, legal and administrative assistance, CAP consultancy, rural development support, fiscal and accounting advisory services, training and professional development programmes, as well as support for internationalisation and market access.
The Federation coordinates five provincial unions (Naples, Caserta, Salerno, Avellino and Benevento), ensuring territorial representation and direct support to local agricultural enterprises. In addition, it works closely with several specialised organisations such as Agriturist, ANGA, ANPA, Confagricoltura Donna, Confagri BIO Campania, CAA Confagricoltura and Gestioni Assicurazioni Agricole, which contribute to strengthening services and representation across the agricultural sector.
Through its structured governance and extensive network of enterprises and stakeholders, Confagricoltura Campania plays an important role in promoting innovation, knowledge transfer and sustainable development within the regional agri-food ecosystem.

Carbon is the currency of life. Where it flows, biology adapts. Where it accumulates, systems destabilise.
RumenAI was founded on a simple conviction: to optimise living systems, we must first measure them at their biochemical core.
At the heart of the company’s innovation is a patented, miniaturised spectroscopic platform embedded within a biocompatible ruminal bolus. Once deployed inside the rumen — one of nature’s most complex anaerobic bioreactors — the device autonomously and continuously quantifying dissolved CO₂ and other critical fermentation intermediates.
Measure: RumenAI captures real-time carbon speciation and gas–liquid mass-transfer dynamics directly within a dense, multiphase biological reactor — a domain previously inaccessible to continuous monitoring.
Analyse: Embedded edge processing and AI-driven spectral modelling transform raw signals into dynamic carbon-flux intelligence, revealing metabolic stability, fermentation efficiency, and early stress signatures.
Optimise: The resulting insights guide farmers to generate precise feeding strategies, prevent metabolic disorders, improve nutrient utilisation, increase productivity, and reduce methane emissions.
By shifting farm management from reactive intervention (detection) to predictive control (Prevention), RumenAI enables more efficient, resilient, and climate-conscious livestock systems.
By making carbon visible, RumenAI transforms biological complexity into measurable performance, enabling smarter food systems today and informing controlled life-support systems of tomorrow.

Azolla Projects is a Barcelona-based, purpose-driven company dedicated to enabling and financing the transition to regenerative agriculture, transforming it into a scalable farming model.

Azolla Projects is specialised in the design and implementation of projects related to carbon farming and natural capital, regenerative agriculture and ecosystem services in agricultural and land-use systems. The company works on projects that translate environmental performance into decision-relevant outcomes for public and private stakeholders.
Azolla Projects has experience in structuring complex, multi-actor initiatives in the agri-food sector, including EU-funded R&D projects, policy-oriented activities and collaborations involving research institutions, farmers, value-chain actors and public authorities. A core area of expertise of the company lies in the deployment of monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) approaches, as well as in the alignment of project outcomes with evolving European regulatory and certification frameworks related to climate mitigation, adaptation and sustainability.
Building on this foundation, Azolla Projects has also worked closely with financial institutions and public bodies on topics related to sustainable finance, including participation in advisory processes linked to government-led initiatives. Through this work, the company has developed a solid understanding of financial risk analysis methodologies, sustainability-related regulatory and reporting obligations affecting the financial sector, and the implications of financing decisions, including fiscal and regulatory considerations associated with green and non-green investments.
Azolla Projects brings specific experience in ESG-related reporting frameworks and in the interpretation of portfolio and value-chain-level impacts financed by financial institutions, including Scope 3–type considerations beyond carbon, such as water, land-use and broader environmental externalities. This perspective is directly relevant to financial institutions obligations to assess, manage and mitigate the impacts associated with the activities they finance.
Azolla Projects contributes its capability to translate Earth Observation–based drought resilience indicators into economically interpretable signals aligned with financial risk assessment, project viability analysis and sustainability-aligned decision contexts. This combination of technical, regulatory and financial interpretative expertise complements the Earth Observation and modelling capabilities of Future Water and directly supports the objectives of the proposed research.

SiPearl is an European fabless designer of high-performance energy-efficient processors for HPC, AI and data centres. These processors will help address strategic dual-use challenges in the fields of security, defence, medical research, energy, climate and engineering with a reduced environmental footprint.
SiPearl is thus contributing to Europe’s technological sovereignty.

Created by Philippe Notton in June 2019, SiPearl is the company bringing to life the European Processor Initiative(EPI) project. The aim of EPI is to foster the deployment in Europe of high-performance and energy-efficient processor technologies. Privately held, SiPearl is supported by the European Union and France.
SiPearl designs European processors that help Europe’s supercomputers to achieve exascale power. It works through close collaboration with its 30 partners from the EPI consortium – scientific community, supercomputing centres and leading names from the IT, electronics and automotive sectors – which are its stakeholders, clients and end-users.
Since its operational launch in January 2020, SiPearl has been financially supported by the European Commission under the Horizon Europeprogram.

description:
Onetreck is building the next generation of autonomous medical systems for missions on Earth and in space, ensuring that no human is left without care when support collapses.

Born in the French Alps and accelerated from the national AI excellence cluster (MIAI, UGA, CNRS), we are fully industry-driven and design sovereign, resilient clinical intelligence capable of operating in the world’s most degraded environments.

Our flagship system, Manta Voyager, is a TRL 5–6 ultra-compact edge-AI medical module that delivers real-time, clinician-level guidance without connectivity. 
Entirely on-device. No cloud. No tracking. No dependency.

Onetreck is supported by leading scientific, defense, space, and hardware institutions including CNES, DGA, AID, and NVIDIA. The company is laureate of BPI France (BFTE), MedInTechs, the French Tech HIIT Program, the CLARA R2B Prize, and is accelerated by ESA BIC in Aerospace Valley.

Tested with university hospitals such as AP-HP Paris and already deployed in demanding field evaluations, our system is engineered for extreme robustness. Onetreck is also preparing for orbital mission integration, supporting next-generation space-medical autonomy.

entityDescription: A.N.E.V. CONSULTING Services Ltd is a forward-thinking, for-profit organization dedicated to advancing research and innovation in cognition and E2STEAM (Entrepreneurship, Environment, Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics). With a strong emphasis on fostering innovation and STEAM capacity, the company collaborates with various stakeholders and external funding sources, including the EU, to support its endeavors. Under the umbrella of A.N.E.V. CONSULTING Services Ltd, three distinct entities operate with regal names: STEMFREAK, Institute for STEAM Education, and ROBO Each of these entities plays a vital role in promoting excellence and innovation in STEAM education and related fields. The Institute for STEAM Education spearheads several noteworthy projects, including the development of a Certification Scheme for STEAM students, schools, and educators in collaboration with the Cyprus Certification Company. Additionally, the Institute has undertaken extensive research and development efforts to create an Interactive Educational STEAM Program, which integrates multiple disciplines seamlessly. This program, piloted and validated over several years, is designed to cater to students aged 5 to 18, offering comprehensive interdisciplinary learning experiences. STEMFREAK, another integral arm of the organization, offers STEAM Educational Programs both conventionally and through an innovative E-Learning Platform. The program is designed to cater to students of all ages, with a focus on providing flexible, high-quality STEAM education. Through franchise packages, STEMFREAK extends its reach to other educational organizations, enabling them to deliver blended STEAM education effectively. ROBO, the third component of A.N.E.V. CONSULTING Services Ltd, is deeply involved in robotics education and innovation. From distributing basic robotics components to designing and producing educational STEAM kits tailored to STEMFREAK's program, ROBO plays a crucial role in empowering the maker community and advancing robotics education in Cyprus and the EU. One of the notable aspects of the Institute for STEAM Education's projects is its focus on astronomy-related education. Dr. Andri Vrioni, the driving force behind the Institute's initiatives, has authored books that integrate astronomy into STEAM education, providing interdisciplinary activities for learners of all levels. Furthermore, research papers presented by Dr. Vrioni and her team delve into the learning outcomes of VR/AR-STEAM blended learning environments, emphasizing the importance of incorporating modern technology into educational practices. In summary, A.N.E.V. CONSULTING Services Ltd and its affiliated entities are at the forefront of promoting innovation and excellence in STEAM education, with a particular emphasis on interdisciplinary learning and leveraging modern technologies. Through their diverse projects and collaborations, they are actively shaping the future of education in Cyprus and beyond.

description:
Tess Space is a deep-tech robotics company and spin-out from Space Robotics research, developing AI-based autonomy software for unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) operating in complex outdoor environments.
The company’s core technology is an AI-driven Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) system that enables autonomous navigation, sensor fusion, and mission execution in rugged and unstructured terrain.
Core application area:
Security and surveillance: Autonomous UGV navigation for patrolling, situational awareness, and monitoring of large outdoor areas such as critical infrastructure, borders, and industrial sites. Industrial inspection and resource operations: Autonomous ground robots for inspection, data collection, and monitoring in sectors such as energy, infrastructure, and mineral extraction in remote or hazardous environments and Arctic. Environmental and biodiversity monitoring: Autonomous robotic systems for long-term monitoring of ecosystems, forests, and wildlife, enabling large-scale data collection with minimal environmental disturbance.
Tess Space builds on more than 20 years of experience in robotics and artificial intelligence research, originating from Aalborg University’s Space Robotics activities, combining academic research with real-world robotic system development and deployment.
